column7: A FIFO named as the CLI CA file (--ca-file / KEYORIX_CA_FILE / ca_file) hung the command in open(2) until a writer appeared, before the IsRegular check could run. LoadCAPool now opens O_NONBLOCK and refuses a non-regular file on the opened descriptor; the test fails if the call has not returned within 1s. PR #3182 (cli module, own go.mod: checked by check-closures.sh inside cli/).
